units.source_text: 天将高高的举起三叉戟，向对面山顶的天空一晃。

en.t: The heavenly general raised his trident high and gave a sweep toward the sky above the mountain peak opposite him.

units.source_text: 让人不可思议的是，黑暗瞬间被撕破，无数天兵列队占满整个天空，他们手中的刀枪熠熠发光，潮水般涌向杜子春。

en.t: Astonishingly, the darkness was torn open in an instant, and countless heavenly soldiers filled the whole sky in ranks; the swords and spears in their hands gleamed as they surged toward Du Zichun like a tide.
